articles.title: A Proposal in the Rain
articles.text: On a rainy evening, an elderly tailor climbed to the eighth floor to present a proposal for repairing the community hall. Several residents began to yawn, but he had to admit that his dear old building needed more than fresh curtains or paint. He asked every tenant to participate by listing one skill, from wiring to budgeting, that could serve their mutual goal. The room became lively as people discovered that shared work could make the plan affordable and keep the hall open.
articles.translation: 一个雨夜，一位年长裁缝爬到八楼，提出修缮社区礼堂的建议。几位居民开始打哈欠，但他承认，这座珍爱的老建筑需要的不只是新窗帘或油漆。他请每位住户参与，列出一项能服务共同目标的技能，从布线到预算都可以。大家发现共同劳动能让方案负担得起并保住礼堂，房间里顿时活跃起来。

articles.title: What Organic Farming Changes
articles.text: An organic farm keeps an extensive record of soil, insects, weather, and each cup of water used on a test plot. Drip irrigation keeps roots moist while leaving leaves apart from wet soil, where a beetle's claw may carry disease. A solar generator can power pumps, but farmers must adapt planting dates before they expect a substantial change in yield. Afterward, several seasons of records show whether the new system improved soil rather than merely changing a label.
articles.translation: 有机农场会详细记录土壤、昆虫、天气以及试验田使用的每一杯水。滴灌保持根部湿润，同时让叶片远离湿土，因为甲虫的爪可能传播病害。太阳能发电机可以为水泵供电，但农民必须调整播种日期，之后才能期待产量显著变化。随后，数个季节的记录会显示新体系是否真正改善土壤，而不只是换了标签。

articles.title: Villages Need Reliable Local Power
articles.text: A rural clinic should not depend on being lucky enough to have a clear day whenever it must charge a medical vehicle. Solar panels can provide clean power, while an organic fuel system may help during cloudy weeks, but both require storage and repair skills. Communities should investigate ownership openly; a generator must not become a political conquest claimed by a communist group or any other party. Local committees can stir debate, test costs, and choose a mixed system that keeps essential services running.
articles.translation: 乡村诊所不应依赖好运，不能只有晴天才能给医疗车辆充电。太阳能板可以提供清洁电力，有机燃料系统则可在多云数周时帮忙，但两者都需要储能和维修技能。社区应公开调查所有权；发电机不应成为某个共产党组织或任何其他政党争夺的政治战利品。地方委员会可以推动讨论、检验成本，并选择保障基本服务运转的混合系统。
